description: This file contains utility functions for converting a CameraX ImageProxy object to a Bitmap, specifically providing the method 'imageProxyToBitmap'. It handles YUV image buffers and encodes them into JPEG format before decoding into a Bitmap.

classes.name: ImageUtils
classes.description: Utility object providing image conversion methods, notably converting an ImageProxy to a Bitmap.

methods.name: imageProxyToBitmap
methods.description: Converts a CameraX ImageProxy object into a Bitmap by processing YUV buffers and encoding them as JPEG.
